Application Data.NAME: Greenfield Golf & Sports Equipment Store
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Greenfield Golf & Sports Equipment Store specializes in the retail sale of golf clubs, balls, apparel, and various sporting accessories. We operate from a secure location with a professionally monitored alarm system. Our store is well-maintained, adheres to clear safety protocols, and has a strong track record of liability management, ensuring minimal risk of slip-and-fall incidents. We do not engage in any rental operations or sell firearms, focusing solely on new merchandise to maintain a controlled inventory environment. Regular training for staff on safety and customer service enhances our operational efficiency and customer satisfaction.

Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On 08/15/2022, our store experienced a theft incident where $1,500 worth of golf clubs and accessories were stolen from the premises. The theft was promptly reported to the local authorities, and we have since implemented additional security measures, including enhanced surveillance and employee training on theft prevention. The claim was settled with the insurance provider, and we received compensation of $1,000, with the remaining loss absorbed by our operational budget. The incident is now considered closed, and no further action is pending.
Application Data.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Class B, Grade II, UL Listed
Application Data.OTHER PROTECTION: Monitored security system with surveillance cameras, motion detectors, and regular safety audits conducted by staff. Additionally, we employ a part-time security consultant to review our loss prevention strategies and provide recommendations for enhancement.
